productArea.name: Profiles and account settings
productArea.scope: View and edit profile details, avatars, privacy, and appearance, follow or block users, and inspect the account's owned repositories. Authentication settings, organization management, packages, and webhooks are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Open the fixture user profile and its Followers and Following tabs.
Open the seeded contributor profile to inspect Follow, Unfollow, Block, and social lists.
Choose Settings from the account menu to edit profile details and the avatar.
Choose Appearance to configure language, theme, and hidden-comment preferences.
Choose Blocked users to manage the blocked-user list.
Choose Repositories in account settings to inspect owned repository listings and pagination.
